scientific_integrity: The original payoff and one-mode dispersion mechanism are attributed to Roy et al.; the claimed contribution is a maximal disconnected-window theorem and normalized weighted-star realization for every habitat count. Rational interval computations and an analytic all-order spectral proof are provided. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Local linear exponential stability of the homogeneous positive state; at thresholds a neutral eigenvalue occurs and no exponential stability classification is claimed. Nonlinear pattern existence/global convergence are unproved. Positively weighted stars extend the original article's unweighted graph assumption. Historical-priority comparison is bounded by inspected literature.
title: Maximal disconnected mobility-instability windows in an ecological cooperation network
